svg.aria-label: Davit Toroyan, Full-Stack Developer in Yerevan, Armenia. Full-stack developer with 3+ years of commercial web development at a digital agency. I build and maintain websites, online stores, and web apps for businesses in Russia, Armenia, and Germany on Next.js, TypeScript, WordPress, and Laravel. I work AI-first with Claude Code and Cursor and review every change myself before it ships.
